easyPrerequisites: You control an additional non-Spirit creature.
description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a non-Spirit creature
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating two creature tokens due to Quina.
When the creature tokens enter, Blasting Station triggers twice, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.
